missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend caffeine for performance or alertness without reviewing sleep symptoms, intake and timing; encourage clinical assessment for persistent insomnia.
safety_exclusions: Do not use caffeine as a treatment for chronic sleep problems.
Do not assume caffeine is the sole cause of insomnia.
Do not advise changing prescribed medicines.
professional_escalation_conditions: Persistent insomnia, excessive daytime sleepiness, suspected sleep apnea, mood symptoms or safety-critical sleepiness.
Pregnancy, cardiovascular disease or stimulant medication use.
population_and_context: People reporting poor sleep or insomnia who may be exposed to caffeine; timing and total daily intake can affect sleep, but sleep symptoms have multiple possible causes.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Review total daily caffeine and timing; avoid prescribing a universal cut-off without considering sensitivity and sleep schedule.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS exercise fact sheet discusses caffeine use and adverse effects; sleep-specific guidance should be cross-checked against current sleep-medicine sources.
